note: Inputs for tools/beta-analyze run. Refusal reasons follow the intake check (names outside the allowlist, absolute or .. names, a symlink external_attr, an entry over 50 MB, a total over 200 MB, a compression ratio over 100); quarantine follows the verify step (a manifest sha256 mismatch, or a pattern-class hit: absolute paths, /Users/, /home/, e-mail, URL with a host). good-1-copy.zip is byte-identical to good-1.zip under another name (dedupe). `{{plugin}}` in the bundles stays a placeholder: a case renders the brand (or the old name, AT-WB-14) before it runs the analyzer. The oversize entry declares 60 MiB in both headers but holds 3 bytes, so only a size check that reads the headers refuses it.
